result:
I fixed 12 rules in `pricebook.py` whose behaviour didn't match their docstrings. A script then checked all 150 rules against their docstrings, and every rule now matches.

| Rule | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 11 | Discount started above 12, not at 12 | Now starts at 12 units |
| 15 | Discount started above 100, not at 100 | Now starts at 100 units |
| 18 | The cap only kicked in once the discount went over 200,000 won | The 100,000 won cap now always applies |
| 28 | Marked "whole" but only discounted the units above the threshold | Now discounts the full amount |
| 44, 79, 139 | Discount was rounded, not rounded down to the won | Now rounded down, like the other rules |
| 65 | The 30,000 won cap was applied to the price before the discount was worked out | The cap now applies to the discount |
| 91 | Discount started at 13 units, not 12 | Now starts at 12 units |
| 105 | Used 9% instead of 8% | Now 8% |
| 119 | Discount started at 31 units, not 30 | Now starts at 30 units |
| 127 | Discount started above 30, not at 30 | Now starts at 30 units |

The checking script is in `/tmp/chk/check.py`, outside the project.

STATUS: DONE
